bagPolicy.summary: The Boch Center entry policy describes guest screening but does not publish a fixed Wang Theatre bag size or clear-bag rule.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Nearby options include Tufts Medical Center Garage adjacent to the Wang and other Theatre District garages. Check the venue directions page for booking and access.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Lyft is the Boch Center’s official rideshare partner; the FAQ does not specify a separate loading location at the Wang Theatre.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Concessions are sold in the theatre lobby. Whether purchased food and drinks may go into the auditorium depends on the show.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible seating is available in portions of the orchestra and orchestra boxes. The Wang has a Grand Lobby elevator to all floors and a chair lift to its Lower Lobby.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The venue FAQ does not state a general re-entry policy; some forced-will-call events require immediate admission without readmittance.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Will Call is typically available one hour before curtain with ID and either confirmation number or purchasing card. The box office also opens Tuesday–Saturday noon–6 p.m.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The theatre screens guests at entry and can deny admission to a guest who declines screening; check the specific show for its doors and any added security rule.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
